styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.SEOBINE: a woman of about forty five with black hair tied in a low bun at the nape, a gray hemp jacket and a dark gray skirt, a plain calm face with smooth skin
characters.DEUKI: a lanky boy of fifteen as tall as a grown woman, a long black braid hanging over his shoulder in front, a white cloth band on his forehead, a patched gray hemp jacket and short trousers
characters.DORYEONG: a lanky boy of fifteen as tall as a grown woman, a long black braid hanging over his shoulder in front, a white cloth band on his forehead, a pale blue silk jacket and white trousers
characters.MANIM: a woman of about thirty five with black hair in a neat bun with a gold pin, a green silk jacket and a long red skirt, a smooth youthful face
characters.SATTO: a man in his fifties in a crimson official robe and a wide black gat, a full black beard

scenes.S01: A close view of SEOBINE from the chest up filling the frame, her lips pressed together, her eyes steady and looking slightly down. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S02: Only one woman here: SEOBINE standing with her head low and her hands folded, a wooden gate and a tiled wall close behind her filling the frame, pine branches across the top. Daylight.
scenes.S04: Only one woman here: SEOBINE sitting on a wooden floor beside a low wooden cradle, rocking it with one hand, a folded quilt and a low chest beside her, a latticed paper door filling the wall behind. Morning light.
scenes.S05: Only one woman in the picture: SEOBINE pressing a folded cloth to her chest and looking out of a doorway, her face tired, a dim room. Daylight.
scenes.S06: Nobody in the picture: an extreme close view of one bowl of thin rice gruel with a wooden spoon resting in it, the bowl filling most of the frame, a dark water jar right behind it and a folded cloth beside it, all touching the edges of the frame. Lamplight.
scenes.S07: SEOBINE seen from behind, sitting on the floor with her back to the viewer, her head bent low over a bundle in her arms, a folded quilt beside her. Warm lamplight, a quiet room.
scenes.S08: SEOBINE seen from behind, sitting on a floor cushion, turning a white swaddled bundle in her arms from one side to the other, a latticed paper door filling the wall in front of her. Warm daylight.
scenes.S10: A very close view of a baby whose head and body are wrapped in white cloth lying on a folded quilt, only the small mouth and chin visible, a woman's finger beside the mouth, the white wrapping filling the frame. Warm light.
scenes.S11: Only one woman here: SEOBINE sitting alone on a wooden step at dusk with a folded cloth in her lap, a tiled wall and a wooden pillar close behind her, pine branches across the top. A quiet courtyard.
scenes.S12: A large tiled house at night with lanterns lit in two separate rooms, servants hurrying across the yard, seen from outside. No large faces.
scenes.S13: Only one woman here: SEOBINE seen from behind, carrying a white swaddled bundle across a dark courtyard, walking quickly, tiled roofs and a lit lantern close around her filling the frame. Night.
scenes.S14: A large tiled house at night with orange firelight glowing behind one wing, people running with water buckets across the yard, seen from a distance. No large faces.
scenes.S16: SEOBINE seen from directly behind, her back and shoulders filling the frame, her head bent down and turned slightly, her arms curved in front holding a white cloth bundle hidden behind her shoulder. Lamplight.
scenes.S17: A very close view of a swaddled baby's mouth and chin only, a woman's fingertip at the corner of the small mouth, white wrapping cloth filling the rest of the frame. The head is out of frame. Warm lamplight.
scenes.S18: Only one woman in the picture: SEOBINE standing in a doorway at night holding a lamp, looking into a dark room, her face tight. Night.
scenes.S19: A close view of SEOBINE from the chest up, both hands pressed to her mouth, her eyes wide. Her face and hands fill the frame, a dark room behind. Lamplight.
scenes.S20: Only one woman in the picture: SEOBINE lying awake on a thin mat in a dark room, her eyes open, staring upward. Night.
scenes.S21: [SIL]Sunset over a tiled roof village, a woman standing alone in a courtyard as a black silhouette, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind them.
scenes.S22: Exactly two people: DORYEONG sitting at a low desk with an open book in a bright room, and SEOBINE standing far back by the door with a tray. Daylight.
scenes.S23: Only one boy in the picture: DEUKI carrying two water buckets on a shoulder pole across a yard, his back bent, a plain wall behind. Daylight.
scenes.S24: A close view of SEOBINE from the waist up standing in a kitchen doorway, her hands in her apron, earthen jars close on both sides of her filling the frame. Daylight.
scenes.S25: A close view from the waist up of MANIM kneeling with her hand at her mouth, an open lacquered box close in front of her, a painted folding screen right behind her filling the frame. Daylight.

scenes.S27: Every man wears Korean hanbok with a topknot or a black gat. Several servants standing in small groups in a courtyard talking quietly, glancing toward a closed storeroom door. Daylight.
scenes.S28: A close view of SEOBINE from the waist up sitting by a dying kitchen fire, her face lit from below, stacked firewood and earthen jars close behind her filling the frame. Night.
scenes.S29: A close view of two women only: SEOBINE bowed with her forehead to the floor, MANIM seated just in front of her looking down. Daylight.
scenes.S30: A close view of MANIM's face, pale and frozen, her eyes wide, a blurred bright room behind. Nobody else.
scenes.S31: Exactly two people: SEOBINE kneeling and pointing at her own open mouth with one finger, and MANIM leaning forward to look. A bright room, daylight.
scenes.S32: Exactly two people: SEOBINE kneeling with her head low, and MANIM standing with one hand on the door frame, her back half turned. A bright room.

scenes.S35: Exactly two people: DEUKI standing with his mouth open and his tongue reaching up over his upper lip, and MANIM staring at him. A bright room, daylight.
scenes.S36: Only two people and nobody else: SEOBINE kneeling low on the bare ground of a county office courtyard, and SATTO seated alone on the wooden veranda above her. Daylight.
scenes.S37: Exactly two people: SATTO seated on a veranda leaning forward, and a village midwife in a gray hemp jacket kneeling below and speaking. Daylight.
scenes.S38: Only one boy in the picture: DEUKI standing alone in a courtyard in a clean white jacket, his hands hanging, his face stunned. Daylight.
scenes.S39: DEUKI and DORYEONG, both the same height and both fifteen years old, standing face to face in a courtyard. Daylight.
scenes.S40: SEOBINE kneels with her head low. MANIM sits a few steps in front of her, leaning forward to listen. Two women only, daylight.
scenes.S41: A close view of SEOBINE's lined face, her eyes wet and steady, looking slightly upward, a blurred bright room behind. Nobody else.
scenes.S42: DEUKI sits on the left of a low table and DORYEONG on the right, both the same height, facing each other and eating from bowls. No third person. Daylight.
scenes.S43: Only one woman in the picture: SEOBINE sitting alone on a wooden step in the sun with her hands in her lap, her eyes closed, a quiet courtyard behind. Daylight.
scenes.S44: [SIL]Sunset over a tiled roof house, two young figures and one older woman standing in a courtyard as black silhouettes, layered silver clouds and a band of gold light behind them.
